cues: Demography is the counting of people.
Births add them, deaths remove them, migration moves them.
The crude birth rate is live births per thousand people a year; the crude death rate, deaths per thousand.
Their difference is the rate of natural increase.
And the infant mortality rate is infant deaths per thousand live births, not per thousand people.
That denominator is the classic trap.
